about: The secreta of the formulary “Fourth Sunday after Epiphany” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Grant, we beseech Thee, almighty God, that the gift of this sacrifice which is offered may ever cleanse and protect our frailty from all evil. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God,
